name: Pixie
bio: Pixie, a cute small butterfly: a soft cream-and-tan furry body with darker brown markings down her abdomen, large rounded wings patterned in lilac-purple, pale blue and cream with soft yellow spots, fine pink-red veining and a thin warm gold edge, two long curling gold antennae each tipped with a tiny point of light, a small round cream face with very large dark eyes ringed in amber, soft eyelashes, rosy cheeks and a tiny smiling mouth, and two small teardrop-shaped tails hanging from her lower wings
invariants: lilac-purple, pale blue and cream wings with soft yellow spots and fine pink-red veining
a thin warm gold edge running all the way around the wings
two long curling gold antennae, each tipped with a tiny point of light
a soft cream and tan furry body with darker brown markings down the abdomen
very large dark eyes ringed with amber, soft eyelashes and rosy cheeks
two small teardrop-shaped tails hanging from the lower wings
forbidden: a different wing pattern, wing shape or wing colour
Pixie wearing clothing, jewellery or accessories
a realistic or anatomically detailed insect; she is a soft storybook butterfly
visible insect legs beyond small tucked forelegs
habit: her antennae curl in and the tips glow a little brighter when she is delighted
notes: The cover art lives at assets/characters/covers/pixie.png and has her name and
tagline painted into it. The generation reference at assets/characters/pixie.png
is a separate, TEXTLESS sheet derived from that cover.
This split is new with Pixie. The seven original characters use their cover as
their reference, so the painted title is in the seed on every page of every
book, held back only by the prompt insisting on no text. Do it Pixie's way.
